
## Summary

**Remove internal scrollbars from mandatory triage panels** (residual after DUX5)

Scope, action, handoff and help panels hide required content behind internal scrolling.

## Priority / wave

- Priority: **P0**
- Wave: **V1**
- Complexity: **M**
- Audit code: `UX-P0-02`
- DUX code: `DUX6-02`

## Scope

Run Explorer, Incident Workspace, Data Quality, Overview, Trust.

Screenshot groups: SG-01,02,03,06,07

## Concrete change

Auto-size required text panels to a strict 2–4 line budget. Move documentation and endpoints to descriptions, tooltips and runbook links.

## Expected effect

The first action and reason remain visible at 100% and 125% zoom.

## Acceptance criteria

- Zero internal vertical scrollbars in first-screen status/reason/action panels at 1366×768, 1440×900 and 1920×1080.
- Live/screenshot evidence at 1366×768 (blocking) after change
- No new high-cardinality Prometheus labels
- No hidden verdict logic only in Grafana transforms

## Dependencies

Copy rewrite and grid reflow.

## Risk

Taller panels may push diagnostics below fold; this is acceptable when priority is preserved.

## Predecessor / residual notes

#7118 DUX5-02 closed — residual: re-audit still reports triage scroll in places

## Constraints

- Surgical dashboard JSON; preserve panel IDs where possible
- Prefer description/runbook for caveats; first-screen ≤2–4 lines
- Tech-debt budgets non-increasing

## Verification

- [ ] Before/after screenshots (dark)
- [ ] Viewports 1366/1440/1920 @100% (125% if layout-sensitive)
- [ ] Targeted pytest if JSON structure changes
- [ ] 5-second operator comprehension on first-screen card
